snippet.title: Ironwing Valiant Cutscene System Update
snippet.description:
Hey guys, firstly I want to say happy Lunar New Year. 
恭喜發財
新年快樂
闔家歡樂
身體健康!
Secondly, I wanted to share to you a short clip of the cutscene system we are implementing. It's almost finished but we are still able to make our visual novel style cutscene with them. Anim, face shape, model is still WIP and we receive many feedback from our Discord community on how to improve where we are lacking. Please give us any feedback you have and let us know what you think in the comments!
